chapter: New York, the Lafayette and the Cotton Club
title: Territory bands he heard and the Moten-Basie link
summary: Crawford says he never met Bennie Moten, notes Basie took over Moten's band, and lists Alphonso Trent, Speed Webb and Zack White as the best bands he heard.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Now, when you all were working in -- during the '30s you were working through the territories, did you meet -- did you --
Now, did you meet -- did you meet -- say, Benny Moten or any of those --
None of those guys came through --
Basie -- Basie took over Benny = wonderful guy. Moten's band, Moten's band, and Basie's the one. Yes.
So what were the big bands? I mean what were the most impressive bands that you heard during those years when you all were in --

Well, you had a band. I was starting in Memphis, naturally. Alphonso Trent -- and then I go up to Cincinnati territory then -- Speed Webb, Zack White, Helvey's Helvey Helgren's -- Helgren and -- oh, where am I, Cincinnati?
Then in Cleveland you had a band by (Doc... --) the name of -- he was a society type band. Maybe somebody else can remember.
